author: GameTrailers
description:
IGN Fan Fest 2026: Fall Edition is here! The showcase kicks off at 10am PT / 1pm ET for exclusive reveals from TV series including Cyberpunk: Edgrunners, Blue Eye Samurai, IT: VisionQuest, The Walking Dead: Daryl Dixon, and many more. 

On the movie side, we'll have reveals from Whalefall, I Play Rocky, How to Rob a Bank, Ebenezer, and more! 

Lastly, on the games side, there will be tons of exclusive game trailers from exciting titles including Dragon Ball Xenoverse 3, WWE 2K26, 007: First Light, Where Winds Meet, MARVEL Cosmic Invasion, and many others.

Make sure to also check IGN.com for all the reveals and news coverage as the show goes on!

#IGN #FanFest
title: IGN Fan Fest 2026: Fall Edition Livestream – Dragon Ball, VisionQuest, Whalefall, and More!

author: GameTrailers
description:
Shadow of the Road is a tactical RPG set in an alternative version of 19th-century Japan. The new trailer reimagines the game as a shounen anime, complete with an epic soundtrack. The "anime opening" features the song METAHOPE by Japanese hypermetal band Earthists and depicts the main characters and their friendship, effort, and victory in their struggle against the forces of the Emperor.


#ShadowOfTheRoad #Gaming #IGNFanFest2026
title: Shadow of the Road - Official Anime Opening Trailer | IGN Fall Fan Fest 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get a look at the Release Date Trailer for Blind Descent, an open-world survival adventure game developed by Pokuch. Players will explore the great mysteries of Mars alone or with friends in co-op. Craft tools, overcome hazards across the planet, and adapt to ever-changing environments. Blind Descent is launching into Early Access on December 2 for PC (Steam, Epic Games Store, and GOG).

#BlindDescent #Gaming #IGNFanFest2026
title: Blind Descent - Official Release Date Trailer | IGN Fall Fan Fest 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Discover for the first time the Dawn of the Delta expansion for Anno 117: Pax Romana. Enter the new province of Aegyptus and take on the ambitious project to restore the great Pyramids in Rome’s honor.

#Anno17PaxRomana #Gaming #IGNFanFest2026
title: Anno 117 : Pax Romana -  Official Pyramids Trailer | IGN Fall Fan Fest 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Mobile Launch Trailer for Sifu, the hit third-person action combat game developed by Sloclap. Players will master combat abilities from stage to stage on a road paved by vengeance, and death is far from the end. Fight age in Sifu, available now for iOS and Android.
title: Sifu - Official Mobile Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the music video for "Burn The Sky," by Casey Edwards & Ollie Swift, a new music track from the Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen expansion for the action RPG! 

In Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen, the fantasy world has been expanded with new tales and encounters. Embark to a snowy new area in the north: the long-abandoned Norgan region, and take on 12 new dungeon challenges spread across the existing world of Dragon's Dogma 2. Bring your Arisen and Pawns to life with new hairstyles and tattoo options. 

Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen arrives on Nintendo Switch 2, containing both the Dragon's Dogma 2 base game and the Dark Arisen Expansion content in one package. The Dark Arisen Expansion will be available as a separate DLC on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC. Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, PC, and Nintendo Switch 2.

#DragonsDogma2 #Gaming #IGNFanFest
title: Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen - Official 'Burn The Sky' Music Video | IGN Fall Fan Fest 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Gameplay Trailer for Rust Dungeon, an arena first-person shooter developed by Vulflock. Players will fight through corridors of enemies to attain upgrades, find mods, and master the game's movement mechanics to survive. Rust Dungeon is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Rust Dungeon - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the release date trailer for Vicarius, a hack-and-slash set in an interconnected world mixing single-player extraction with Metroidvania elements. In this action-adventure game, you ascend into a world you know nothing about. Everything will try to kill you. No tutorial. No direction. No map. No goal given. Minimal user interface. You can only count on yourself. Vicarius is available now on PC (Steam).
title: Vicarius - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Chapter 1 Launch Trailer for Hytale, an early access adventure creation RPG developed by Hypixel Studios. Players can now access new content, with the Forgotten Temple being accessible to players with new Goblin Gadgets, a new Guttering Hollows biome, abilities, and more. Chapter 1 of Hytale is available now for PC.
title: Hytale - Official Chapter 1 Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the iOS Deep Dive Trailer for No Man's Sky, the open-world sci-fi action-adventure game developed by Hello Games. Players will take in the wonder, exploration, and adventure of No Man's Sky on the go with the iOS release. The iOS version is packed with built-from-the-ground-up touch controls, remarkable battery life and thermal performance, and more. No Man's Sky is launching on October 28 for iOS.
title: No Man's Sky - Official iOS Deep Dive Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Never Fight Alone Morida Trailer for Gears of War: E-Day, the latest installment in the third-person action cover shooter developed by The Coalition. Players can access the Never Fight Alone charity bundle, packed with the Legendary Character Skin, a weapon skin, and other cosmetic items, with all net revenue going to Crisis Text Line. The Never Fight Alone charity bundle is available now in Gears of War: E-Day for Xbox Series X|S and PC (Steam).
title: Gears of War: E-Day - Official Never Fight Alone Morida Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: The Old West is corrupted by the occult, and it's up to you to fight to survive in this isometric action-RPG. Check out the new trailer showing off the "Liquid Courage" game mechanic that turns alcohol into a powerup, and wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3574750/The_Dark_West/
title: The Dark West: Official "Liquid Courage" Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Release Date Trailer for He-Man and the Masters of the Universe: Dragon Pearl of Destruction, a 2D arcade hack-and-slash beat 'em up developed by Bitmap Bureau. Players will wield the sword of legend to embody He-Man and other beloved heroes from Eternia. Master abilities, fight through diverse levels, and witness an '80s cartoon legend come to life. He-Man and the Masters of the Universe: Dragon Pearl of Destruction is launching on February 4, 2027, for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam).
title: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe: Dragon Pearl of Destruction - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Totally Safe Moon Project gets a new trailer showcasing chaotic multiplayer gameplay and a release date. Check out the latest Totally Safe Moon Project release date trailer for this upcoming online co-op platformer game. In Totally Safe Moon Project, a giant asteroid is about to destroy the Earth! The Moon is your last hope. Work together with friends to build a tower from everyday objects.
title: Totally Safe Moon Project - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Demo update trailer for Asthenia, a first-person dark fantasy action-adventure game developed by Matthaios Lappas. Players assume the role of Adam on a quest through a dimension plagued by disease and ruled by cosmic entities. Engage in combat, uncover secrets, and explore the lands of Asthenia to survive. Asthenia is coming soon to PC (Steam), with an updated demo available now on Steam.
title: Asthenia - Official Demo Update Trailer
